chrisc / pixmo-points-with-masks-v16

The same pixmo images and points we already sample, with three things added that we currently pay to reconstruct or guess: real COCO-RLE masks (on 46% of annotations, so the official PointingEval mask test can run exactly instead of on SAM reconstructions), a human audit_result per annotation, and ready-made negative phrases. 223,572 images, last written 2026-08-21.

Below: the dataset's own points rendered with our SoM marks, with the shipped mask shaded green where one exists. Points are 0-100 normalised; masks are COCO RLE at the image's own size.
